metadata.task_description: P1-2 Daily Watchlist Generator — 基于 P1 Market Semantics（交易日历、复权、北向资金、指数成分）和 P5 DataSource，整合信号评分、事件驱动、持仓状态，生成个性化每日关注列表

project_context.name: SYNAPSE
project_context.type: AI-native Quant Research OS for A-share market

quality_gates: All new schemas must have to_dict/from_dict round-trip tests
Schema version bump for breaking changes (Lazy Upcast)
AI-generated content marked with source_type: ai_generated

source_code.rationale: Existing basic watchlist generator — needs scoring, ranking, filtering, market-semantics integration, and personalization. Currently 191 lines, simple merge of events+signals+positions.
WatchlistEntry schema — needs priority_score, reason field; TriggerType may need SECTOR_ROTATION addition. SignalType enum defined here overlaps with schemas/signal.py (different enums, intentional).
Signal schema v2.0 with decay_tracking hook — input to watchlist scoring. SignalType here differs from watchlist.py SignalType (6 types vs 6 types, same values but separate enums).
Event schema v3.0 with severity/confidence/decay_rate — key inputs for event-driven watchlist entries. PropagationGraph integration needed.
Position schema with thesis_status and attention_state — used for portfolio-aware watchlist entries and priority scoring.
Base class — MarketContext.research_date/market_date used for date-aware filtering.
P1 Market Semantics API — calendar validation, northbound signals, index constituent filtering. All ready to integrate.
Trading calendar — validate target_date is a trading day before generating watchlist.
Northbound flow signal generation — convert large northbound flows to Signal-compatible dicts for watchlist entry.
Index constituent filtering — restrict watchlist universe to tracked indices.
Price adjustment — may be needed for factor-based scoring if comparing adjusted prices.
DataSource ABC — adapter protocol for fetching real-time data (quotes, capital flow) used in scoring.
8 concrete event detectors — produce Events consumed by watchlist generator.
DAG for event propagation — used to compute cascaded event impact scores for watchlist ranking.
Event decay model — critical for scoring: newer events rank higher, stale events decay.
Impact analysis — compute cascaded impact scores from propagation graph for watchlist ranking.
Factor engine — compute factor values (momentum, value, quality) for scoring anomalous signals.
Factor specification — defines factor identity, lookback, data source. Factor-based anomalies feed watchlist.
Projection engine — watchlist_generator is one of 4 projections. P1-2 enhances it.
Position rebuilder — rebuild positions from decisions. Positions feed portfolio-aware watchlist entries.
Daily research workflow — orchestrates watchlist generation. P1-2 will enhance this to pass market-semantics context.
Activity logging — watchlist.generated is already logged here.
ID generation — generate_id('wl') used for watchlist entry IDs.
YAML load/save — save_watchlist uses save_object for WatchlistEntry serialization.
EastMoney adapter — real-time quotes and capital flow data for scoring.
Akshare adapter — alternative data source for market data.

tests.rationale: Existing watchlist generator tests — TestWatchlistGenerator class with 5 tests. P1-2 must extend this with scoring/ranking/filtering tests.
Round-trip test pattern for all schemas — WatchlistEntry to_dict/from_dict round-trip tests exist.
Trading calendar tests — P1-2 uses is_trading_day for validation.
Northbound flow tests — P1-2 uses northbound_to_signals.
Constituent tests — P1-2 uses constituent_tickers for universe filtering.
Event detection tests — detectors produce events consumed by watchlist.
Factor engine tests — factor-based scoring integration.
Impact analyzer tests — cascaded impact scores for watchlist ranking.

external.usage: DataFrame operations for factor computation and signal aggregation
Numerical operations for scoring weight computation
YAML serialization for watchlist entries and scoring config

breaking_changes: WatchlistEntry schema may need new fields (priority_score, reason) — non-breaking via Lazy Upcast if added with defaults
generate_daily() function signature will expand with new optional parameters — backward compatible
WatchlistEntry has SignalType enum that overlaps with schemas/signal.py SignalType (different enums with same values) — potential confusion but no actual conflict

critical.rationale: Primary modification target — existing basic generator (191 lines) needs scoring, ranking, filtering, market-semantics integration. Currently has generate_daily() and save_watchlist() as entry points.
Schema to extend — WatchlistEntry needs priority_score, reason, and possibly additional SignalType values. TriggerType may need SECTOR_ROTATION.
Trading calendar — is_trading_day() validates target_date before generation. next_trading_day() for date fallback.
Northbound flow — northbound_to_signals() converts large flows to Signal-compatible dicts. northbound_momentum() for rolling momentum scoring.
Index constituent — constituent_tickers() for universe filtering. is_member() for individual checks. load_constituent_changes() for rebalance signals.
Event decay model — CATEGORY_HALF_LIVES dict (earnings=6.5d, policy=1.5d, sentiment=2.0d, etc.) and compute_decay() for scoring stale events lower.
PropagationGraph — bfs_downstream() for cascaded event impact, apply_decay_to_edges() for temporal decay, topological_sort() for processing order.
Event v3.0 schema — severity, confidence, decay_rate, propagation_state fields are key inputs for event-driven scoring.
Signal v2.0 schema — signal_type, strength, decay_tracking, first_seen_at for signal-based scoring. Note: SignalType here is different from watchlist.py SignalType.
Position schema — thesis_status (ACTIVE/WEAKENED/INVALIDATED) and attention_state (STABLE/RISING/FADING) for portfolio-aware priority.
Existing watchlist tests — TestWatchlistGenerator class. P1-2 must add scoring/ranking/filtering tests following same pattern.

Daily research orchestrator — run_daily_research() calls generate_daily(). P1-2 will enhance to pass market-semantics context (calendar, northbound, constituent).
BaseSchema foundation — MarketContext.research_date/market_date used for date-aware filtering and scoring.
8 event detectors — produce Events consumed by watchlist generator. Understanding detector outputs helps design scoring.
Serialization — save_object() used by save_watchlist(). May need new register_object_type() for scoring config.
Activity logging — watchlist.generated already logged. P1-2 may add scoring breakdown to activity.
EastMoney adapter — real-time quotes and capital flow for scoring.
